Injective maps T³→T³ are homeomorphisms by invariance of domain and hence degree ±1; |m²−4m+2|=1 precisely m=3 for integer m≥2. At m=3 the k=(0,1,1) matrix is unimodular; compact C¹ stability of nonsingular derivative and covering degree +1 proves the nearby diffeomorphism.
